thesis: A calm consultation briefing that gives one dominant clinical priority to the professional and one obvious next step to the patient, with supporting context deferred to an intentional overlay.

composition: A deep-ink navigation rail anchors both views while the content rests on the warm off-white canvas.
Expediente uses one editorial clinical-priority field, a compact appointment block, and two measured signals instead of a uniform dashboard grid.
Portal uses a single daily sequence as the dominant surface, with habits, appointment, and message compressed into a supporting column.
The first portrait in the supplied synthetic strip is cropped into a small rounded identity tile and never treated as a hero image.
hierarchy: Patient identity and the next consultation frame the clinician view before diagnosis, safety facts, and trend values.
The portal leads with lunch as the next action; breakfast completion, habits, appointment, and message remain secondary.
Large Figtree-like headings contrast with compact Plus Jakarta Sans-like body labels while using only local system fallbacks.
interaction: Expediente and Portal are keyboard-switchable tabs with synchronized selected and hidden states.
Abrir contexto launches a fixed modal panel above either current view without reserving layout space or changing the document scroll position.
The panel supports backdrop close, close-button focus, a focus loop, Escape close, and focus restoration to the exact trigger.
Reduced-motion preferences collapse animation and transition durations.

expressive_opportunity: The oversized diagnosis field and quiet orbit motif make clinical priority feel like a composed briefing rather than another card collection, while the portal translates the same visual identity into a reassuring sequence.
concrete_risk: The editorial scale of the diagnosis works for the supplied short priority but could consume too much space with longer real clinical labels or additional mandatory warnings; production adaptation would need constrained-content testing before preserving this exact scale.

limitations: This is one cohesive exploratory direction and has not been presented to or approved by a user.

Verification was intentionally focused on local static content, embedded JavaScript syntax, asset resolution, and repository whitespace; no live browser walkthrough or independent visual acceptance was claimed.
No external font files are loaded, so typography uses named local fallbacks that approximate the product's Figtree and Plus Jakarta Sans pairing.
The available HTML Tidy executable predates HTML5 and could not provide meaningful semantic validation.
A composite checker was blocked by the repository shell guard before execution; equivalent checks were rerun as simple explicit commands.
